notes: The model's horizontal origin is sceneOriginProjected (in crs). When northRotationDeg is non-zero, the exported model was rotated by that many degrees so the selection's edges are axis-aligned in the file; to recover real-world coordinates, rotate model plan coordinates back by northRotationDeg (clockwise, about the origin) and add sceneOriginProjected, dividing by printScaleMmPerMeter/1000 first if the export was print-resized. footprintCornersLngLat pins the model footprint's corners to the ground directly.
